subject: Next steps: PO onboarding & vendor registration for CustForge
messages:
From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@custforge.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@custforge.com
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor registration and PO requirements for Redwood

Hi Connor —

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement is ready to kick off vendor onboarding so we can start issuing POs to Redwood. I attached a short PO requirements packet and our supplier registration checklist. High-level items we need from your side to avoid AP delays:

- Completed supplier registration form (we prefer a PDF or DocuSign flow)
- Bank remit info + EFT test file (they run a verification)
- Tax evidence: W-9 (US) or VAT registration + EU tax evidence where applicable
- Billing format: PDF invoice with separate CSV line export OR EDI 810 (we most often use the CSV template in the packet)
- PO number must appear in the invoice header and line items; our PO prefix is CF-
- Payment terms: standard is net-30 unless a different arrangement is agreed

Attached: PO_instructions_CustForge.pdf (contains CSV template and portal steps).

Two quick Qs for you so we can provision your supplier account in our portal:
1) Do you have a legal entity name and exact VAT/TIN to display on invoices?
2) Who will be the primary portal contact for registration (name + email)?

If you can send the supplier form and W-9 by EOD Monday we should be able to issue the first PO in this quarter's run.

Best,
Elena Morris
Sr. Procurement Manager | CustForge
Elena.Morris@custforge.com

Attachment: PO_instructions_CustForge.pdf
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor registration and PO requirements for Redwood

Elena —

Thanks for the clear checklist and the CSV template. Appreciate the timeline. We'll get the vendor packet back to you quickly. Next steps from our side:

1) Laura (cc'd) will own the supplier form and the tax evidence (W-9 / VAT cert).
2) I'll send the bank remit file and Redwood's EFT test sample to procurement.
3) Marcus (cc'd) will confirm billing cadence and whether Redwood can tag line items with the CF- PO prefix automatically from our billing system.

To answer your questions now:
- Legal entity: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Tax: Redwood Inference, Inc. EIN: 12-3456789 (will send signed W-9)
- Primary portal contact: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Attachments we will provide in our follow-up: Redwood_Vendor_Form_Fillable.pdf, Redwood_W9.pdf, EFT_test_file.csv (sample). Expect an initial packet from Laura by Monday COB PST.

Subject: Re: Vendor registration and PO requirements for Redwood

Hi Elena —

I'll take point on the registration. I'll fill the vendor form and upload the documents into your portal. A couple of clarifying items so we provide exactly what AP needs:

- Do you accept a PDF W-9 or do you require the original-signature scan? We have an e-signed W-9 ready.
- For the EFT test: do you require a NACHA-formatted file or will a CSV with bank/routing/account and a small $0.01 test transfer be sufficient?
- On VAT evidence: we're primarily US-entity for this contract. If CustForge needs EU VAT activity later, we will provide supporting regs per-event.
- Billing cadence: Connor mentioned automated tagging for the CF- PO prefix. If Marcus can confirm that via reply, we can map fields into your CSV template (invoice_number, po_number, line_description, quantity, unit_price).

I'll attach the fillable vendor form and the W-9 now. Expect a second email within the hour with the EFT sample file and bank remit PDF.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Finance Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Attachment: Redwood_Vendor_Form_Fillable.pdf
From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@custforge.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@custforge.com
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 13:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor registration and PO requirements for Redwood

Laura / Connor —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Quick answers:
- PDF e-signed W-9 is fine; we just need the tax name and EIN to match the supplier record.
- EFT test: NACHA file preferred but if you can provide a CSV in the portal we'll accept it and run a verification. If possible please include a 0.01 debit credit test indicator in the file so our bank team can reconcile.
- Payment terms for new suppliers will be net-30; once the supplier is fully onboarded we can revisit for early-payment/discount programs.
- PO prefix CF- is confirmed; our portal will reject invoices that don't include a PO in the header.

I'll send the DocuSign link for the supplier agreement to this thread (see link) and our portal contact will send an enrollment invite to Laura. Once the DocuSign is completed and the EFT test is successful we can issue the first PO (CF-xxxxx) the following week.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/CF-Supplier-Agreement-2027

Thanks —
Elena Morris
Sr. Procurement Manager | CustForge

Attachment: see portal notes in PO_instructions_CustForge.pdf
